honor.title: Honor Spots & Prestige of Mallorca
honor.subtitle: A transparent and meritocratic space where residents, clients, and guilds champion their favorite benchmarks. Each honor spot requires a minimum backing of €1 over the previous record. Only real, verified businesses (Zero Fake Data) are eligible for the podium.
honor.guaranteeDesc: Unlike traditional advertising, visibility cannot be bought for mediocre or fake businesses on Servicios Mallorca. To be nominated for the Honor Board, a company must pass an official audit with a confidence score ≥ 80%.
